name: Batch Rename
description: Rename many files at once with rules, a live preview, conflict checks and undo
help: Add files or folders (turn on “Include subfolders” to add their contents too), then build a list of rules. Rules run from top to bottom and the preview updates as you type.
Replace supports plain text or regular expressions ($1 inserts a group). Insert, Remove and Case work on the name, the extension or the whole file name.
Numbering and {n} count files in the chosen sort order. Natural name order puts file2 before file10.
Templates build a new name from tokens: {name} {ext} {n} {n:3} {parent} {date:%Y-%m-%d} and {exif:%Y%m%d_%H%M%S}, which uses the photo's capture time and falls back to the modified time.
Nothing is renamed while any file shows a conflict (two files would get the same name, or a file already exists) or an invalid name.
Files are renamed in two steps, so swapping names and changing only upper/lower case work. If a step fails, everything is moved back. Undo restores the last batch.
